name: Del Residuo al Valor: Economía Circular
description: Four-round simulation placing students as Sustainability Director of Cartón del Plata S.A., a Buenos Aires packaging manufacturer navigating Extended Producer Responsibility legislation, industrial symbiosis networks, and circular business model transformation. Students balance recyclability targets, GHG reduction, and financial performance while designing the transition from linear to circular economy.

this.EPR_PATHS = { pro: { name: 'PRO Membership', compliance: 100, annualCost: 3400000, investment: 0, revenue: 0 }, own: { name: 'Own Take-Back', compliance: 100, annualCost: 1400000, investment: 12000000, revenue: 3200000 }, designout: { name: 'Design-Out', compliance: 85, annualCost: 1600000, investment: 4800000, revenue: 0, feeSaving: 1800000 } }; this.SYMBIOSIS_LEVELS = { none: { value: 0, cost: 0 }, partial: { value: 2500000, cost: 400000 }, full: { value: 6300000, cost: 900000 } }; this.PHASE_NAMES = ['Baseline y Diseño', 'Propuesta de Valor', 'Escala y Simbiosis', 'Roadmap 5 Años']; this.BASE_EBITDA = 0.112; this.BASE_GHG = 9600; } initialize(state) { if (!state.domainState || Object.keys(state.domainState).length === 0) { state.domainState = { totalInvestment: 0, cumulativeRevenue: 0, cumulativeCost: 0, ghgReduced: 0, recyclabilityRate: 42, eprCompliance: 0, symbiosisValue: 0, ebitdaHistory: [], ghgHistory: [], recycleHistory: [], complianceHistory: [], designChoices: [], eprChoices: [], eventLog: [] }; } if (!state.decisions || Object.keys(state.decisions).length === 0) { state.decisions = { designLevel: 'standard', eprPath: 'pro', symbiosisLevel: 'none', wasteTarget: 8, clientPremium: 8, vcDeal: 'reject' }; } this._updateLCA(state); this._setupEventListeners(); this._showRoundSpecificControls(state); } validateDecisions(decisions) { const designSelect = document.getElementById('designSelect'); const eprSelect = document.getElementById('eprSelect'); const symbiosisSelect = document.getElementById('symbiosisSelect'); const wasteSlider = document.getElementById('wasteSlider'); const premiumSelect = document.getElementById('premiumSelect'); const vcSelect = document.getElementById('vcSelect'); if (designSelect) decisions.designLevel = designSelect.value; if (eprSelect) decisions.eprPath = eprSelect.value; if (symbiosisSelect) decisions.symbiosisLevel = symbiosisSelect.value; if (wasteSlider) decisions.wasteTarget = parseInt(wasteSlider.value); if (premiumSelect) decisions.clientPremium = parseInt(premiumSelect.value); if (vcSelect) decisions.vcDeal = vcSelect.value; return true; } calculateResults(state) { const d = state.decisions; const period = state.currentPeriod; const design = this.DESIGN_LEVELS[d.designLevel]; const epr = this.EPR_PATHS[d.eprPath]; const sym = this.SYMBIOSIS_LEVELS[d.symbiosisLevel]; let investment = design.investment; if (period === 1) investment += epr.investment; if (period === 2 && d.vcDeal === 'accept') investment -= 8000000; const wasteSavings = (8 - d.wasteTarget) * 450000; const premiumRevenue = period >= 2 ? (d.clientPremium / 100) * 28400000000 * 0.25 : 0; const eprNetCost = epr.annualCost - epr.revenue - (epr.feeSaving || 0); const totalCost = eprNetCost + sym.cost; const totalRevenue = sym.value + wasteSavings + premiumRevenue; const ghgReduction = design.ghgReduction + (sym.value > 0 ? 5 : 0) + (d.wasteTarget <= 5 ? 8 : 0); const newRecyclability = design.recyclability; const compliance = epr.compliance; state.domainState.totalInvestment += investment; state.domainState.cumulativeRevenue += totalRevenue; state.domainState.cumulativeCost += totalCost; state.domainState.ghgReduced = ghgReduction; state.domainState.recyclabilityRate = newRecyclability; state.domainState.eprCompliance = compliance; state.domainState.symbiosisValue = sym.value; const currentEbitda = this.BASE_EBITDA + (totalRevenue - totalCost) / 28400000000; state.domainState.ebitdaHistory.push(Math.round(currentEbitda * 1000) / 10); state.domainState.ghgHistory.push(ghgReduction); state.domainState.recycleHistory.push(newRecyclability); state.domainState.complianceHistory.push(compliance); state.domainState.designChoices.push(d.designLevel); state.domainState.eprChoices.push(d.eprPath); const npv = this._calculateNPV(state); state.domainState.npv = npv; const results = { period, design: design.name, epr: epr.name, recyclability: newRecyclability, compliance, ghgReduction, symbiosisValue: sym.value, investment, netRevenue: totalRevenue - totalCost, ebitda: currentEbitda, npv }; this._showResults(results); this._triggerRandomEvent(state, period); const maxP = state.maxPeriods || 4; if (period < maxP) { this._showRoundSpecificControls(state, period + 1); } return results; } setupUI(uiManager) { uiManager.bind('currentDay', 'currentPeriod'); uiManager.bind('maxPeriods', 'maxPeriods'); uiManager.bind('recycleDisplay', 'domainState.recyclabilityRate', (v) => v + '%'); uiManager.bind('eprDisplay', 'domainState.eprCompliance', (v) => v + '%'); uiManager.bind('ghgDisplay', 'domainState.ghgReduced', (v) => v + '%'); uiManager.bind('ebitdaDisplay', 'results.ebitda', (v) => (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) ? (v * 100).toFixed(1) : '11.2') + '%'); uiManager.bind('symbiosisDisplay', 'domainState.symbiosisValue', (v) => 'ARS $' + (v / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M'); uiManager.bind('npvDisplay', 'domainState.npv', (v) => 'ARS $' + (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) ? (v / 1000000).toFixed(0) : '0') + 'M'); uiManager.bind('wasteValue', 'decisions.wasteTarget', (v) => v + '%'); } _updateLCA(state) { const d = state.decisions || { designLevel: 'standard' }; const baseCarbon = 48.4; const baseWater = 1840; const baseResource = 312; const baseHazard = 0.84; let factor = 1; if (d.designLevel === 'ecobasic') factor = 0.75; if (d.designLevel === 'ecopremium') factor = 0.59; const carbonEl = document.getElementById('lcaCarbon'); const waterEl = document.getElementById('lcaWater'); const resourceEl = document.getElementById('lcaResource'); const hazardEl = document.getElementById('lcaHazard'); if (carbonEl) carbonEl.textContent = (baseCarbon * factor).toFixed(1); if (waterEl) waterEl.textContent = Math.round(baseWater * factor).toLocaleString(); if (resourceEl) resourceEl.textContent = Math.round(baseResource * factor).toLocaleString(); if (hazardEl) hazardEl.textContent = (baseHazard * factor).toFixed(2); } _setupEventListeners() { const self = this; const designSelect = document.getElementById('designSelect'); if (designSelect) { designSelect.addEventListener('change', function() { self._updateLCA(window.mySimulation.state); }); } const wasteSlider = document.getElementById('wasteSlider'); const wasteValue = document.getElementById('wasteValue'); if (wasteSlider && wasteValue) { wasteSlider.addEventListener('input', function() { wasteValue.textContent = this.value + '%'; }); } const undoBtn = document.getElementById('undoBtn'); if (undoBtn) { undoBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { const st = window.mySimulation && window.mySimulation.state; if (st) self._showRoundSpecificControls(st); }); } } _showRoundSpecificControls(state, periodOverride) { const period = periodOverride || state.currentPeriod || 1; const phaseBadge = document.getElementById('phaseBadge'); const premiumGroup = document.getElementById('premiumGroup'); const vcGroup = document.getElementById('vcGroup'); if (phaseBadge) phaseBadge.textContent = this.PHASE_NAMES[period - 1] || this.PHASE_NAMES[0]; if (premiumGroup) premiumGroup.style.display = period >= 2 ? 'block' : 'none'; if (vcGroup) vcGroup.style.display = period === 2 ? 'block' : 'none'; } _calculateNPV(state) { const ds = state.domainState; const years = 5; const discountRate = 0.12; let npv = -ds.totalInvestment; for (let y = 1; y <= years; y++) { const annualNet = (ds.symbiosisValue + 1800000 + 1200000) - 2000000; npv += annualNet / Math.pow(1 + discountRate, y); } return npv; } _showResults(results) { const panel = document.getElementById('resultsPanel'); const resRecycle = document.getElementById('resRecycle'); const resCompliance = document.getElementById('resCompliance'); const resGhg = document.getElementById('resGhg'); const resSymbiosis = document.getElementById('resSymbiosis'); const resEbitda = document.getElementById('resEbitda'); const resInvestment = document.getElementById('resInvestment'); if (resRecycle) resRecycle.textContent = results.recyclability + '%'; if (resCompliance) resCompliance.textContent = results.compliance >= 100 ? 'Compliant' : 'Partial'; if (resGhg) resGhg.textContent = results.ghgReduction + '%'; if (resSymbiosis) resSymbiosis.textContent = 'ARS $' + (results.symbiosisValue / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M'; if (resEbitda) resEbitda.textContent = (results.ebitda * 100).toFixed(1) + '%'; if (resInvestment) resInvestment.textContent = 'ARS $' + (results.investment / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M'; if (panel) panel.style.display = 'block'; } _triggerRandomEvent(state, period) { const rand = Math.random(); const GATES = { 1: { p: 0.25, key: 'ev1' }, 2: { p: 0.40, key: 'ev2' }, 3: { p: 0.20, key: 'ev3' }, 4: { p: 0.35, key: 'ev4' } }; const gate = GATES[period]; if (!gate || rand >= gate.p) return; const t = (k) => (window.mySimulation && typeof window.mySimulation.t === 'function') ? window.mySimulation.t(k) : k; const event = { key: gate.key, title: t(gate.key + '_title'), desc: t(gate.key + '_desc'), choices: [t(gate.key + '_c1'), t(gate.key + '_c2'), t(gate.key + '_c3')] }; const panel = document.getElementById('eventPanel'); const title = document.getElementById('eventTitle'); const desc = document.getElementById('eventDesc'); const choices = document.getElementById('eventChoices'); if (!(panel && title && desc && choices)) return; title.textContent = event.title; desc.textContent = event.desc; choices.innerHTML = ''; event.choices.forEach((c, idx) => { const btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.className = 'circular-event-btn'; btn.textContent = c; btn.onclick = function() { try { const ds = window.mySimulation && window.mySimulation.state && window.mySimulation.state.domainState; if (ds) { if (!Array.isArray(ds.eventLog)) ds.eventLog = []; ds.eventLog.push({ period: period, event: event.key, choice: idx + 1, label: c }); } } catch (e) {} desc.textContent = t('ev_ack'); choices.innerHTML = ''; const close = document.createElement('button'); close.className = 'circular-event-btn'; close.textContent = t('ev_close'); close.onclick = function() { panel.style.display = 'none'; }; choices.appendChild(close); }; choices.appendChild(btn); }); panel.style.display = 'block'; } getChartConfig() { return { sustainabilityChart: { type: 'radar', data: { labels: ['Recyclability', 'EPR Compliance', 'GHG Reduction', 'Symbiosis Value', 'EBITDA'], datasets: [{ label: 'Current State', data: [42, 0, 0, 0, 11], borderColor: '#2d6a4f', backgroundColor: 'rgba(45,106,79,0.2)', borderWidth: 2 }, { label: 'Round Target', data: [75, 100, 25, 50, 12], borderColor: '#52b788', backgroundColor: 'rgba(82,183,136,0.1)', borderWidth: 2, borderDash: [5, 5] }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { title: { display: true, text: 'Circular Economy Performance', color: '#1b4332' } }, scales: { r: { beginAtZero: true, max: 100, grid: { color: '#b7e4c7' }, pointLabels: { color: '#2d6a4f' } } } } }, impactChart: { type: 'line', data: { labels: ['Baseline', 'R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4'], datasets: [{ label: 'Recyclability %', data: [42, 0, 0, 0, 0], borderColor: '#40916c', backgroundColor: 'rgba(64,145,108,0.1)', borderWidth: 3, fill: false, tension: 0.3 }, { label: 'GHG Reduction %', data: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0], borderColor: '#1b4332', backgroundColor: 'rgba(27,67,50,0.1)', borderWidth: 3, fill: false, tension: 0.3 }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { title: { display: true, text: 'Environmental Impact Trajectory', color: '#1b4332' }, legend: { position: 'bottom' } }, scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true, max: 100, grid: { color: '#e9ecef' }, ticks: { color: '#52796f' } }, x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: '#52796f' } } } } } }; } getChartData(state) { const periods = state.domainState.recycleHistory.length; const labels = ['Baseline']; for (let i = 1; i <= periods; i++) labels.push('R' + i); const recycleData = [42, ...state.domainState.recycleHistory]; const ghgData = [0, ...state.domainState.ghgHistory]; return { sustainabilityChart: { datasets: [{ data: [ state.domainState.recycleHistory[periods - 1] || 42, state.domainState.eprCompliance, state.domainState.ghgReduced, Math.min(100, state.domainState.symbiosisValue / 63000), Math.round((state.domainState.ebitdaHistory[periods - 1] || 11.2) * 10) ] }] }, impactChart: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: recycleData }, { data: ghgData }] } }; } getPerformanceSummary(history) { if (!history.length) return {}; const final = history[history.length - 1].results; const ds = history[history.length - 1].domainState; const recyclability = final.recyclability; const compliance = final.compliance; const ghg = final.ghgReduction; const npv = ds.npv || 0; const ebitda = final.ebitda * 100; let grade = 'Linear Operator'; let message = 'Significant opportunity remains to capture circular value'; let insights = []; if (recyclability >= 75 && compliance >= 100 && ghg >= 25 && npv > 0) { grade = 'Circular Economy Leader'; message = 'Exceptional balance of environmental and financial performance'; insights = ['Achieved premium recyclability rates', 'Full EPR compliance with value creation', 'Industrial symbiosis generating material revenue', 'Circular investments NPV-positive']; } else if (recyclability >= 60 && compliance >= 80) { grade = 'Circular Transitionist'; message = 'Strong progress toward circular business model'; insights = ['Good recyclability improvement', 'EPR compliance strategy working', 'Consider deeper symbiosis partnerships', 'Optimize client premium pricing']; } else if (recyclability >= 50) { grade = 'Compliance Focused'; message = 'Meeting basic requirements but missing value opportunities'; insights = ['Focus on design-for-recycling', 'Explore industrial symbiosis value', 'Calculate total cost of EPR options', 'Develop circular product premiums'];
